meta.name: Oh Hell
meta.description: Bid exactly how many tricks you'll take, then take exactly that many. Hands grow and shrink each round.

labels.max: As many as the deck allows

hook.label: The hook: the dealer can't make the bids add up to the tricks

labels.penalty: 10 + bid when exact, otherwise −1 per trick off

blindBids.label: Blind bids (bid before looking; double if made)

topNoTrump.label: The biggest hand is played with no trump
